native_scope: Godot GL Compatibility, Intel UHD 610; four matched before/after item renders and six posed actor views (two sexes × axe/knife/bow). Automated isolated rendering, not manual gameplay; no movement/projectile/save acceptance for this trial.
findings: Original source palette is purple and nonmetallic; not a missing texture/import failure.
Existing models have no UVs. Trial authored wood UVs, five shared 512px maps, metal bevels, and closed stone blade/lashing.
First sandbox import/runner had inaccessible editor/profile paths and a Godot access violation; isolated APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA/TEMP/TMP resolved this.
First native run failed on missing mipmaps, then timed out; not a pass. Reimport enabled mipmaps without weakening the condition.
Final native pass 52.454 seconds; pre-existing external UID fallback warnings remain in the mirror.
Art review rejected faceted segmented wood silhouettes, angular bow, overly dark steel. Source-model material salvage is insufficient.
Held bow frame shows string extending beyond the tip and cropped upper limb; review framing and final string endpoint alignment require separate checks.
next: Replace complete starter-weapon geometry with coherent authored forms: curved stave/tapered limbs, continuous handles, functional axe head/eye and stone blade. Preserve actual palm anchors, then validate final string endpoints, both-sex action sweeps, released arrows, fletcher workpieces, ordinary world actions, UI and disk before production integration.
